senses.gloss: (b. h.) to grow, swell, be added to.

to add, esp. (of a river) to cast out alluvial soil, make new land Gen. R. s. 13 על הנהר שמְסַפֵּחַ למדינה וכ׳ when a river ameliorates the soil of a district, we say the blessing etc.; Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ מספיק (corr. acc.).
to join, conspire. Tanḥ. Thazr. 11 (play on ספחת, Lev. XIII, 2) שהיה המן מספח עם וכ׳ Haman conspired with Ahasver to destroy etc.
(v. סַפַּחַת) to smite with sores. Pesik. Vattom., p. 133ᵃ (ref. to ושׂפח, Is. III, 17) ואין ספח אלא צרעת sippaḥ means striking with leprosy; Tanḥ. l. c. אין ושִׂפַּח וכ׳; Lev. R. s. 16 הלקן בצרעת.
to attach one’s self, become a citizen.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> end <he>שהניחו ישראל ונִסְתַּפְּחוּ וכ׳</he> they left Israel and became citizens in the fields of Moab.
